findings.summary: toApiError keeps only error.details, but server/http/errorHandler.ts sends the 400 validation_failed `fields` at the top level of error, so CompanyFormDialog.readServerFieldErrors receives nothing and a server-side field error shows only the general message. Client-side validation covers the same rules, so the gap appears only when the server rejects input the client accepts. Outside this unit (primitives/backend): fix by keeping error.fields in ApiError or nesting fields under details.

App.tsx renders <CompanyPage /> without onStartDiagnosis, and src/api/diagnosesApi.ts does not exist yet, so StartDiagnosisButton returns null. A company with no diagnoses shows no start action ('Começar o primeiro diagnóstico' / 'Novo diagnóstico' are hidden). 'Continuar diagnóstico' works through draftId. Deferred to integration after the IF-003 diagnoses unit: pass onStartDiagnosis={(id) => diagnosesApi.startDiagnosis(id)}.

The page shows the latest stage and completion date as text only, with no link to /resultado/:id, because IF-002 Company has no latest completed diagnosis id. Question for integration: add latestDiagnosisId to the backend contract or leave the link to the history phase.

pnpm test:e2e -- tests/e2e/companies.spec.ts was not run because the file does not exist yet (sibling unit). AC-dm-04, AC-dm-05 and AC-dm-06 runtime evidence (create, edit only the target row, archive/cancel, restore with history intact) is deferred to integration; the screens were not exercised against a live API in this review.

evidence.result: exit 0; 0 violations (code-size-limits, coupling-limits, source-code-language-convention, status-change-confirmation OK)

Done-when check: the five unit files call only the IF-002 routes through companiesApi.ts (GET/POST /api/companies, GET/PATCH /api/companies/:id, POST :id/archive, POST :id/restore, DELETE :id). Body fields are name, segment, salesChannel, annualRevenueRange, cnpj, matching IF-002. Company fields used by the screens (latestStage, latestCompletedAt, draftId, completedCount, archivedAt, cnpj, annualRevenueRange) match the IF-002 Company shape. Archive confirmation reads 'Arquivar {nome}?' with the consequence text; restore and delete are offered only on archived rows. No hardcoded ports or external hosts found in the unit files.

messages.text: Keep the server's validation `fields` reachable on the client: either httpClient keeps error.fields (e.g. details = error.details ?? { fields: error.fields }) or errorHandler nests fields under details. CompanyFormDialog already reads details.fields.
After src/api/diagnosesApi.ts exists (IF-003), render <CompanyPage onStartDiagnosis={(id) => diagnosesApi.startDiagnosis(id)} /> in src/App.tsx so the start buttons appear.
IF-002 Company has no latest completed diagnosis id, so CompanyPage cannot link to /resultado/:id. Add latestDiagnosisId to the backend contract, or leave the link to the history phase?
